Title: Hydroponic Nutrients for Tomatoes: Best Fertilizer, EC & pH
Description: Best tomato fertilizer: a low-N, high-K base with calcium nitrate kept apart. Feed 70–150 ppm N by cluster at EC 2.0–3.0 and pH 5.8–6.2. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic tomatoes nutrient solution, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic nutrients
